The '''killscent bomb''' was a weapon created by scientists on [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Description==
Developed by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]], this weapon incorporated [[killscent]], a secretion produced naturally by Bimmiel's native carnivores, the [[slashrat]]s. When the odor was simulated and produced by the [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] could launch the missile at enemies such as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during an attack. Once coated with the substance, the Yuuzhan Vong would be attacked by slashrats and killed by the enraged beasts. During one such application of the weapon, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Ganner Rhysode]] were able to escape with the imprisoned scientists from the planet during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="DTI" />
